coordinateSystem.transformFormat: SOLIDWORKS ArrayData (9 rotation values, 3 translation values, scale, 3 unused values)

loadOrder: Load or generate mesh geometry for each component.requiredGeometryFiles entry.
Create one Three.js object per component using component.id as the stable key.
Apply component.transform.matrix4RowMajor with Matrix4.set(...values), then disable matrixAutoUpdate.
Use mates and mate.entities as native SOLIDWORKS constraint data; threeJsJointHint is only a helper for web playback or physics.
Use motionStudies.frames when present; each frame stores per-component transforms keyed by component.id.
accuracyNotes: .SLDASM stores assembly structure, transforms, mates, configurations, and references to part files; exact visible geometry is in the referenced part files or a mesh export such as GLB.
All transform and mate entity positions are in meters in the SOLIDWORKS assembly coordinate system.
This exporter opens the assembly read-only and closes it without saving, so the source CAD files are not modified.
